Module com.example._0zo
Package com.example._0zo.model.players

Class Player

java.lang.Object
com.example._0zo.model.players.Player
Direct Known Subclasses:
HumanPlayer, MachinePlayer
public abstract class Player extends Object
Abstract base class representing a player in the Cincuentazo game.

Concrete subclasses (HumanPlayer and MachinePlayer) must implement selectCard(int) to define their card-selection strategy. All common state — name, hand, and status — is managed here.

    • Player

      public Player(String name)
      Constructs a player with the given name. The player starts with an empty hand and PlayerStatus.ACTIVE status.
      Parameters:
      name - the display name of the player; must not be null or blank

  • Method Details

    • selectCard

      public abstract Card selectCard(int currentSum) throws InvalidMoveException
      Selects a card from the player's hand to play on the table.

      Implementations must choose a card whose value, added to currentSum, does not exceed 50.

      Parameters:
      currentSum - the current accumulated sum on the table
      Returns:
      the Card chosen to be played
      Throws:
      InvalidMoveException - if no valid card can be selected

    • removeCard

      public void removeCard(Card card)
